user_story: As a user, I want the system to return an error when I try to get a task with a non-existent ID so that I know the task does not exist.

positive.title: Retrieve a task with an existing ID
steps: Send a request to get a task with a valid existing ID
Receive the response from the system
positive.expected_result: The system returns the details of the requested task

negative.title: Retrieve a task with a non-existent ID
steps: Send a request to get a task with a non-existent ID
Receive the response from the system
negative.expected_result: The system returns an error message indicating the task does not exist

edge.title: Retrieve a task with an ID that is an empty string
steps: Send a request to get a task with an empty string as ID
Receive the response from the system
edge.expected_result: The system returns an error message indicating invalid task ID
